title: Forecast Number of Covid-19 Cases Worldwide
brief_summary: Coronavirus disease-19 (Covid-19) had an unprecedented effect on both nations and health systems. Time series modeling using Auto-Regressive Integrated Moving Averages (ARIMA) models have been used to forecast variables extensively mainly in statistics and econometrics. The investigators aimed to predict the total number of cases for Covid-19 using ARIMA models of time-series analysis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Confirmed case of Covid-19

Exclusion Criteria:

* Cases not reported
study_population: Population consists all confirmed cases of Covid-19 reported from Situation Dashboard of the European Center for Disease Prevention and Control website Coronavirus 19 Situation Report
